This identity telescopes for every finite adaptive block-query tree with terminal K retained. No such price is asserted for arbitrary block-query trees. Also 0<=B_nat-R_nat<=(1+2/e)I; R_nat=sum_i M_i^+, B_nat=sum_i H_nat(S_i|S_without_i). exact_statement: For every Boolean sign f on n>=0 uniform bits, every integer N>n with N>=2 and every input x0, put delta=2^-N and g_N=f(x_1,...,x_n)(1-2*1{x=x0}). Then ghat_N(S)=fhat(S)1{S subset [n]}-2delta f(x0)chi_S(x0); every coefficient is nonzero, so every character anchor has top coefficient nonzero and d=N on all sets. U(g_N)=N Var(g_N)-I(g_N), each physical coordinate influence changes by at most 2delta, and ||p(g_N)-p(f)||_1<=4delta(2^(n/2)+1). Put eta=min(2delta(2^(n/2)+1),1-2^-N). Then |H(g_N)-H(f)|<=h2(eta)+eta log2(2^N-1). For every fixed nonconstant seed, H and I converge to seed values and U/I diverges. For any nonnegative support weight psi with max_s psi(s,N)=o(2^N), its edited expectation on nonempty atoms minus sum_nonempty fhat(S)^2 psi(|S|,N) tends to zero. FEI with a fixed constant on this corrected padded-edited class implies FEI with the same constant on every Boolean seed; constants are handled separately.

exact_statement: For any fixed singleton-leaf partition tree with internal cells C_v and child arities b_v, put L(S)=1+sum_v b_v*1{S meets C_v} and <u,v>_L=sum_S uhat(S)vhat(S)L(S). For arbitrary real u,v, <u,v>_L=(1+sum_v b_v)E[uv]-sum_v b_v E[(E[u|C_v^c])(E[v|C_v^c])]. For distinct one-point Boolean edits e_x=-2g(x)1{X=x}, e_y=-2g(y)1{X=y}, the cross is -4g(x)g(y)2^(-2N)sum_v b_v*2^(N-|C_v|)*1{x,y agree outside C_v}. It can be positive despite disjoint physical edit supports: the two-bit x1 seed with edits (+,+),(-,+) gives cross=1/2, individual energies 5/2 and combined energy 6. Moreover for any Boolean core h on a nonempty Y, let g=x1*h(Y), Z={x1,x2}, and join the binary Z tree and any binary Y tree under a binary root. Disjoint proper subcube edits D1={x1=+,x2=+},D2={x1=-,x2=+} have cross=(1+(Eh)^2)/2>=1/2. Their final sign is f=-x1*x2*h, with Gamma(f)=Gamma(g)=5+E_(S_h)W_Y, H(f)=H(g)=H(h), and I(f)=I(g)+1. Thus no finite physical-intersection-density-only bound controls the signed or absolute edit cross; the exact source/edit rebate and retained-core cost cannot be discarded.

exact_statement: For every Boolean seed g on m>=0 uniform core coordinates X, r control coordinates Z, and final physical edit mask E, put F(x,z)=g(x)(-1)^1_E(x,z). Assume every core fiber E_x has at most k assignments, k>=1 and k2^-r<=1/4. Let I_Z and I_X be the final F control/core influence sums, and Q=H(F)-E_z H(F_z), with entropy in bits. Then Q <= K I_Z+2 I_X, K=4r/(r-log2 k)+2/ln2. The core reserve is allocated once to the combined mask; I_X(F)>=I_X(1-2*1_E)>=2 P(E)log2(1/P_X(E_x nonempty)). Empty edit sets have Q=I_Z=0. In particular k=1,r>=2 gives K=4+2/ln2 and k=2,r>=3 gives K<=6+2/ln2. Two graph-controlled events with arbitrary shared core/domains/control maps have <=2 assignments per fiber after either XOR or union-once editing. Every complete physical control-reveal tree has this access price and retains all actual core leaves. If every complete leaf satisfies U<=bI, b>=0, the reviewed local granularity certificate gives H(F)<=max(K,4+2b)I(F). For earlier control-only stopping trees with U-certified leaves, the valid bound is H(F)<=(K+2+2b)I(F), retaining remaining control influence. No arbitrary core-leaf admission is asserted. Dropping the sparse-fiber cap invalidates the ownership inequality: g=(-1)^x and E={(0,0),(1,1)} on one core and one control bit give I_X(F)=0<I_X(1-2*1_E)=1.
hypotheses: Actual Boolean signs on finite uniform cubes; entropy in bits; standard physical pivotal influence.
The seed g is independent of the r control coordinates; the edit mask is the actual final physical XOR or union mask.
Every fiber has cardinality <=k and k2^-r<=1/4; this implies r>=2 and r-log2 k>0.
The full access tree exposes every control and retains the exact actual core restrictions; its reserve is not renewed at descendants.
The U conditions are hypotheses for terminal entropy payment, not consequences of the access bound.
